post.summary: Declare an asset (idempotent) and receive a presigned upload URL while bytes are pending.

get.summary: List assets (keyset-paged, newest taken first by default) with presigned thumbnail URLs. trashed=true lists only the trash.

post.summary: Verify the uploaded bytes and queue processing (idempotent).
Re-queue a Ready or Failed asset through the processing pipeline.
Move an asset to the trash (idempotent). It keeps its bytes and status until restored or purged.
Take an asset back out of the trash (idempotent).
Hydrate up to 200 assets by id — turns relation references into renderable items.

get.summary: Library totals and counts by kind, status, geotag source and month.
Place labels by asset count, most used first — suggestions for the place filter (q = substring).
One asset with presigned original + thumbnail URLs.

delete.summary: Delete an asset permanently, trashed or not: objects first, then the document.

get.summary: Search calendar items (text + tag + parent + attendee contact + category/status filter; recurrence expanded in-window; from/to match occurrences overlapping the window). Text queries and parent/contact filters with no from/to match all-time; otherwise the window defaults to ±1 year. skip/take page over occurrences sorted by start (desc=true for newest first). Only items accepted into a calendar you can read.

post.summary: Link many references of one kind to an item at once (idempotent per reference) — e.g. an album's photos to its event.
Unlink many references of one kind from an item at once (idempotent: references with no matching edge are ignored).

get.summary: Every edge of one kind the caller can see, with its item and reference — e.g. all photo links.

ActionKind.description: A deterministic, no-LLM action executed directly at fire time.

AvailabilityStatus.description: A presence/availability segment's status. A day may hold several segments (whole-day or timed).

BookingDetail.description:
A reservation/confirmation attached to any category (a booked meal, a ticketed outing, a hotel, a flight).
            `ProviderContactId` reuses a `Contact` (airline, hotel, restaurant, venue); `PartySize` covers a
            table/seat reservation; `Amount`/`Currency` the paid cost.

CalendarEntryStatus.description: Curation state of a CalendarItem within a calendar. `Removed` is retained as a sync tombstone.

excludedOccurrences.description: Recurring items: unmodified starts removed from the series.

extraOccurrences.description: Recurring items: one-off starts added to the series.

occurrenceOverrides.description: Recurring items: occurrences that deviate from the series (null members inherit).

oneOf.description: Event-bound payload (server-side only). At most one of ItemPrompt? CalendarItemDto.Prompt/ItemAction? CalendarItemDto.Action is set.
How well-documented this item is (null = not applicable, e.g. exempt kinds/calendars). Drives Elicit ranking.

createdAt.description:
Server-side timestamps (from the event timeline) + stream version — the ordering/versioning
            surface offline clients key on. `Etag` stays content-derived and is orthogonal.

calendarIds.description: Accepted calendar memberships, limited to calendars the caller can read.

parentItemId.description: Hierarchy link (e.g. the trip a leg belongs to). Title only when the caller can read the parent.

childCount.description: Direct children visible to the caller, independent of the current filters.

oneOf.description: The item's own completeness (same across its occurrences; null = not applicable), so search results rank directly.
Provenance of a read-time-projected occurrence (e.g. Birthdays → a contact). Null for stored items.

CalendarItemOccurrenceDto.description: A single concrete occurrence of an item within a search window (recurrences expanded).

CompletenessGap.description: A field the record is missing or thin on, with its rubric weight (heavier = ask first).

CompletenessScore.description:
How well-documented a record is: `Score` 0..1 (Σ weight·presence / Σ weight), the unmet
            fields ranked by missing mass (weight·absence, largest first), and the rubric version that produced it.
            `null` (not this type) means "not applicable".

CreateRelationsBatchRequest.description: Many references of one kind linked to one item in a single call (e.g. an album's photos to its event).

requiredHeaders.description: Headers the PUT must echo — they are part of the presigned signature.

DeclaredPhotoResponse.description:
Declare outcome. UploadUrl is present only while the asset still needs bytes (status
            Declared); an already-uploaded asset returns its status so the client skips the transfer.

capturedByContactId.description: The photographer's contact — the phone sends its owner's own contact.

DeclarePhotoRequest.description:
Client-side MediaStore metadata for one asset. (DeviceId, MediaStoreId) under the caller is
            the idempotency key — retrying a declare returns the same asset.

DeleteRelationsBatchRequest.description: Many references of one kind unlinked from one item in a single call (e.g. photos removed from an event's album).

FallbackMode.description: On a missed contract: retry once then ask (Retry), ask immediately (Ask), or drop (Drop).

GapSeverity.description: A field is fully present, weak/partial (0.5), or absent.

GpsRejectionDto.description: A fix the GPS sweep rejected; processing skips it until restored.

ItemAction.description: A deterministic payload executed directly (no LLM). `ParamsJson` carries the frozen params (e.g. a SendCheckIn message).

ItemAttendeeDto.description: One attendee's participation, composed from the participation events.

ItemDetails.description:
Composable, category-independent detail for a CalendarItem: any of a reservation (BookingDetail? ItemDetails.Booking),
a movement leg (TravelLeg? ItemDetails.Travel, a `Trip` only), or an availability segment (PresenceDetail? ItemDetails.Presence). Each is
an optional value object rather than a per-kind member, so one event can carry several at once (a booked flight sets both
BookingDetail? ItemDetails.Booking and TravelLeg? ItemDetails.Travel). Location (venue, hotel, clinic) uses the item's `PlaceId`
(a LupiraGeoApi place id) + `LocationLabel`; provider/driver references reuse a `Contact` id.

ItemPrompt.description: An LLM-interpreted, contracted payload → an agent run. Declared at authoring time; enforced by assistant-api at fire time.

LookupPhotosRequest.description:
Hydrates a set of asset ids in one call — used to turn calendar-item relation references
            into renderable items.

OccurrenceOrigin.description:
Ties a projected occurrence back to the entity it was derived from — the birthday occurrence's
            Guid OccurrenceOrigin.SourceId is the contact whose birthday it is.

OriginKind.description: What a read-time-projected occurrence was synthesized from.

OutputKind.description: The ProposedAction kind a run is contracted to yield (assistant-api validates against it; cal-api only stores it).

ParticipationRole.description: An attendee's role in an item.

duplicateOfId.description: On a Duplicate only: the asset that holds the bytes.

purgesAt.description: When the trash is purged of it (`TrashedAt` + retention); null unless trashed.

thumbUrl.description: Presigned GET, long expiry; null until processed.

originalUrl.description: Presigned GET, short expiry; only on the single-asset endpoint.

lastError.description: Only set on a Failed asset — lets the health view explain itself without a per-item fetch.

duplicateOfId.description: On a Duplicate only: the asset that holds the bytes.

purgesAt.description: When the trash is purged of it (`TrashedAt` + retention); null unless trashed.

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor; absent on the last page.

byCamera.description: "Sony G8341" → count; what the importer's camera map is built from.

PresenceDetail.description:
A presence/availability segment's status; the span is the item itself (whole-day or timed). Replaces the old
            Availability item kind — presence items live on the availability calendar and are exempt from completeness scoring.

PromptFire.description:
Fire timing (flattened union): OnStart/OnEnd carry nothing; Offset uses `OffsetMinutes` (negative = lead time);
            AllDayAt uses `AllDayAt` (local wall-clock time on the occurrence date).

PromptFireKind.description: When a payload fires relative to its item's occurrence.

PromptIntent.description: What an LLM-interpreted run should accomplish.

Ref.description: A reference the fired payload acts on. `Id` for Event/Contact/Task; `Url` for External.

TakenAtSource.description:
Where DateTimeOffset PhotoAsset.TakenAt came from. TakenAtSource.Device is first so documents
            written before the field existed (phone backups) read as it.

TransportMode.description:
Mode of a TravelLeg. Rail split: `Train` = mainline/commuter, `Metro` = rapid transit,
            `Tram` = light/narrow-gauge rail; `Coach` = long-distance bus vs local `Bus`.

TravelLeg.description:
One leg of a `Trip`. Mode-agnostic: `DeparturePoint`/`ArrivalPoint` generalize gate/platform/stop,
            `Carrier` the airline/operator, `ServiceNumber` the flight/train/service number. `ToPlaceId`/`FromPlaceId`
            are LupiraGeoApi place ids with denormalized `ToLabel`/`FromLabel`; `DriverContactId` names the driver
            for a TransportMode.Car leg.

Cookie.description: Session cookie minted by the BFF's OIDC login.
Cookie.name: __Host-lupira-photos

Bearer.description: Authentik access token from a native client; audience must include lupira-photos.
